description: Use this tool to turn a GTIN/EAN (plus optional lot and serial number) into a conformant GS1 Digital Link URL, the QR payload required for Sunrise 2027 retail QR codes and EU Digital Product Passport data carriers. If the GTIN check digit is wrong it explains why and suggests the corrected number. Deterministic, no account needed.

base.description: Optional https resolver origin you control; default https://id.cycle-platform.com

name: build_gs1_digital_link
